As it turns out, i had manage to build myself, an Exynos powered Android smart TV/Gaming centre/Wirelessly controlled desktop, using mostly stuff that i already owned and was gathering dust out in the shed that had been packed up after the last moved and upgraded with more expensive but ulltimately more disposable gear.

-So a TV i wouldnt get $50 for at Cash Converters,

-A dock i could buy at Cash Converters for probably $50,

Bluetooth mouse connected instantly, but cant for the love of god find my ol little bluetooth keyboard... somehow, someone has thought to make the ol Logitech wireless USB stuff completely compatible with all this so that worked instantly.
